name: Hetaireia Guards

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.text: The unit's morale cannot be broken for an extended period of time.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Disciplined
attributes.text: This unit does not suffer a morale penalty when the general dies. It can also rally after routing more often.

attributes.name: Encourage
attributes.text: This unit provides a morale bonus to nearby allies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

short: Like the Companions before them, these men swear an oath to defend the Empire.
history: As the Eastern Roman Empire based its operations out of Constantinople it inevitably inherited more local, Hellenised motifs, echoing the great empire of Alexander and his Successors that came before it. One such echo was the forming of 'hetaireia', meaning 'company', a troop of bodyguards to the Eastern Roman Emperor that could apparently trace its heritage back to the Macedonian Companion Cavalry, or 'hetairoi'. Hetaireia existed alongside tagmata, a broader division of elite Imperial protectors established by Constantine the Great shortly before the Roman Empire split into its Eastern and Western divisions.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
